title: lathyrus polymorphus subsp. incanus
intro: Lathyrus polymorphus subsp. incanus, commonly known as the hairy vetch, is a species of flowering plant in the legume family, Fabaceae. It is a perennial herb that has been traditionally used in various cultures for its medicinal properties, offering several health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects. The therapeutic actions of Lathyrus polymorphus subsp. incanus are attributed to its ability to act as an anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiseptic agent, making it useful in treating various conditions including wounds and infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
